DecisionCode.description: Machine-readable outcome of an authorization decision. Branch on this, not on reason.

resource.description: Resource pattern, for example mcp:github:* or tool:file_read

actions.description: Allowed actions: read, write, execute, delete, or *

type.description: `device` is the backing agent of an IoT device, created by the device routes.

token.description: Agent token. The plaintext value is returned only by create and rotate, empty otherwise.

cnf.description: Sender constraint of the token (RFC 7800): jkt for a DPoP key, x5t#S256 for a client certificate. Absent for a bearer token.

score.description: 0 to 1, closeness of the grant to the request

arguments.description: JSON text with secret-looking keys redacted, cut at 2 KB

requiredAcr.description: Approving needs a sign-in that reached this acr (RFC 9470). Absent: no step-up rule

maxAuthAge.description: Approving needs a sign-in event at most this many seconds old

acr.description: RFC 9470: authentication context class reference of the login

amr.description: RFC 8176 authentication methods of the login

auth_time.description: RFC 9470: epoch seconds of the user's authentication event

act.description: RFC 8693 actor claim: sub and client_id of the actor, with act nested for earlier hops

sub.description: The user who owns the agent

cnf.description: RFC 7800 confirmation claim: jkt for DPoP, x5t#S256 for mutual TLS

actor.description: Who ran the admin MCP call, a label chosen by the caller

ref.description: One way reference to the session, never the session id or a token

cascade.description: This link plus every active downstream link

denied.description: A revocation row already exists for this link

BearerAuth.description: A signed-in user session, or the principal your authenticate hook resolves

DeviceCredential.description: A device pre shared key (tdk_...) or a device assertion JWT (typ device-assertion+jwt). A client certificate checked by your proxy also works when devices.clientCertThumbprint is set.

ClientBasic.description: OAuth client credentials. client_secret_post and private_key_jwt are also accepted in the form body.
